definitions.explanation: The act of receiving orders from customers or clients for goods or services.

examples.japanese: {今月|こんげつ}の{受注|じゅちゅう}{件数|けんすう}が{増|ふ}えた。
examples.english: The number of orders received this month increased.

examples.japanese: {受注|じゅちゅう}を{確認|かくにん}する。
{受注|じゅちゅう}{生産|せいさん}で{製品|せいひん}を{作|つく}る。
examples.english: To manufacture products on a made-to-order basis.

notes:
COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {受注|じゅちゅう}する (to receive an order)
- {受注|じゅちゅう}{件数|けんすう} (number of orders received)
- {受注|じゅちゅう}{生産|せいさん} (made-to-order production)
- {受注|じゅちゅう}{残高|ざんだか} (order backlog)

RELATED TERMS:
- {発注|はっちゅう} (placing an order) - opposite
